dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They are both nice water, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: #Well said, Nara {NICKNAME}. Nara {NICKNAME}, so smart, as if you have been drinking Vanarana water all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: #This time, soup using Vanarana water for Nara {NICKNAME}. Next time, I will find nicer water.
